_comment: Shared keep-all (CSS word-break: keep-all) vectors. Read by coui_core
the Chrome probe in tool/parity — a change to which pairs stay together
fails on every platform at once.
joins: `expected` is the Flutter display string — a U+2060 WORD JOINER
(escaped \u2060) wherever keep-all removes a break opportunity. The Web
never changes the string; Chrome's own keep-all removes the same
opportunities (the Chrome probe checks every row).
lines: the same text laid out at one width in Pretendard Regular, with
and without keep-all, on both platforms. Trailing spaces are trimmed —
they hang past the line end on both. `keepAllFlutter` overrides
`keepAll` for Flutter only where the two line breakers knowingly

lines.difference: Chrome moves an over-long word to a fresh line before breaking inside it (overflow-wrap: anywhere breaks only where a line has no other opportunity). Flutter's line breaker may start breaking it on the current line instead.
